_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Welding Procedures
summary: The Welding Procedures DID specifies format and content requirements used by the Government to verify contractor-designated welding responsibilities and implement weld procedures for contractors, sub-contractors, or welding entities performing specified work.
use_relationship:
The Welding Procedures will be used by the Government to verify contractor designated welding responsibilities and implement weld procedures for each Contractor, Sub-contractor, or welding entity performing welding on specific work specifications.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific requirement delineated in the contract.
This DID supersedes DI-MISC-80875.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content:
The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

Reference. Requirements for Welding and Brazing Procedure and Performance Qualification S9074-AQ-GIB-010/248. Copies of this document may be obtained by contacting the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO).

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Welding Procedures shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Welding Procedures shall include a title page specifying the following information:

children.title: System name/identification number (i.e. hull number, tail number, etc.)
The Welding Procedures shall contain all elements
children.content: listed in S9074-AQ-GIB-010/248, paragraph 4 for each applicable procedure. Sketches and drawings shall be included to fully describe or clarify the text material (if applicable).
